newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open firmer, in line with Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open firmer, in line with Wall Street.

text.p: UK shares opened higher on Friday after Wall Street stocks surged to a seventh consecutive record close overnight, but gains are likely to be capped as the domestic market dwells on Thursday's rise in retail prices.

The FTSE 100 index was up 15.8 points at 3,941.9 by 0842 GMT after the Dow was inspired by subdued inflation data to end 38.76 points better at 6,274.24. The average was up 17 points as London markets closed.
UK gilts opened higher in line with advances in Treasuries and Bunds. The December long gilt future was up 9/32 at 110-03/32 after climbing nearly a point on Thursday.
